description: Read raw browser evidence collected since session start: requests, responses, pending/completed/failed state, HTTP status, loading failures, CORS/blocked reasons, console messages, exceptions, and screenshot events. Pass the returned cursor as since for an incremental read, or request_id for one request. This surface does not diagnose payment stages. Released card PAN/CVV copies are masked; status bodies and all unrelated values remain visible.
name: operate_network
